What's New
  INTERNET-BASED UPDATES (that's why you're seeing this)

  Added new RIGHT-CLICK menus & edit options for improved efficiency

  Added Option Branches for paths - (Right Click or Properties menu)

  Expanded route and path editing

  Improved individual segment selection and editing
  Segment controls available directly in the Properties panel
  Bracket Tool Improvements

  Pass Protection - Full OL Drawing Improvements

  Improved Playlist tools

  Multi-select playlist actions
  Duplicate selected plays
  Duplicate + Flip selected plays
  Remove multiple selected plays
  Additional stability, selection, path editing, and UI improvements
